verdict.rationale: FireHydrant Signals documents on-call schedules built from rotations: a schedule is a collection of rotations tied to a team, each rotation defines the timing and assignment of shifts, and schedules can be escalation-policy targets. Preserved schedule overrides and support hours add further flexibility. Multiple rotations per schedule loosely covers layering, but time-zone handling and round-robin coverage have no evidence. missing for 10: documented time-zone configuration for rotations, round-robin coverage, explicit layer semantics and depth, independent or hands-on corroboration
